results.question: What five principles underpin the UK's AI regulation framework?
results.answer: Based on the ingested documents: A pro-innovation approach to AI regulation 67 Part Five: Territorial application 5.1 Territorial application of the regulatory framework 113 [2]. Our AI regulation framework applies to the whole of the UK [2]. A pro-innovation approach to AI regulation 78 Annex B: Stakeholder engagement B.1 Summary In July 2022, we published a policy paper outlining our proposals for Establishing a pro-innovation approach to regulating AI.179 We proposed a non-statutory framework underpinned by a set of cross- sectoral principles including transparency, safety, and security [3]. The principles were intended to guide how regulators approach AI risks [3]. Our innovative approach to AI regulation uses a principles-based framework for regulators to interpret and apply to AI within their remits [4].

results.question: Will the UK put its AI principles on a statutory footing initially?
results.answer: Based on the ingested documents: We will not put these principles on a statutory footing initially [1]. New rigid and onerous legislative requirements on businesses could hold back AI innovation and reduce our ability to respond quickly and in a proportionate way to future technological advances [1]. We will not put these principles on a statutory footing initially [2]. Initially, the principles will be issued by government on a non-statutory basis and applied by regulators within their remits [3]. We will support regulators to apply the principles using the powers and resources available to them [3].
